name: Abuja National Mosque
subtitle: Nigeria's national mosque, in the capital, is known for its golden dome and four minarets.

facts.label: Features
facts.value: A golden dome and four towering minarets

facts.label: Council founded
facts.value: 1981, inaugurated by Sultan Abubakar III of Sokoto

facts.label: Visitors
facts.value: Open to visitors of all faiths

parts.text: Nigeria's national mosque, in the capital, is known for its golden dome and four minarets. The Nigerian press calls it the country's largest mosque.
